Description:
Most bars built for oily skin work by stripping it. Yours ends up tight and squeaky for an hour, then produces more oil than it started with. The Active Defense Bar is formulated around that exact problem.

Activated charcoal and neem do the heavy lifting: charcoal binds to the excess sebum sitting deep in your pores and pulls it out, while neem's anti-microbial compounds go after the bacteria driving your breakouts. Tea tree essential oil handles fungal acne and the inflammation that comes with an active flare-up, and tulsi works underneath all of it to keep sebum production steady.

What keeps the bar from over-drying is the oil balance. The coconut oil carries a cleansing value of 67, which is what gives you a genuinely deep wash. The olive oil carries a conditioning value of 82 - rich in oleic acid, it puts moisture back as you rinse. You get the cleanse without losing the moisture barrier that keeps oil production in check.

Cold-process, small batch, no synthetic detergents.
Meta: _econur_positioning: Deep-cleansing charcoal and neem bar for oily, acne-prone skin - controls oil and breakouts without stripping.

Neem fights acne at the source :: Neem carries powerful anti-microbial compounds that reduce the bacteria behind breakouts, while keeping everyday itching in check.
Tea tree oil calms inflammation :: Tea tree essential oil targets fungal acne specifically and settles the redness and swelling of an active breakout.
Tulsi supports oil balance :: Holy basil works alongside the other botanicals to keep sebum production steady instead of swinging between oily and tight.
Cleansing without stripping :: Coconut oil brings a cleansing value of 67 for a deep wash, while olive oil's oleic acid (conditioning value 82) restores moisture so the skin barrier stays intact.

Description:
Pigmentation does not lift overnight, and any bar that claims otherwise is selling you something. This one works the way skin actually responds: gradually, with consistent use.

Licorice is the active that matters here. It is one of the most effective natural ingredients on melasma, acne scarring and general pigmentation, and it works by evening tone out rather than bleaching it. Wild turmeric lifts tan and dullness alongside it, while honey holds moisture at the surface so skin looks vibrant instead of tight after washing.

Aloe vera runs through the bar as a hydration and calming agent, and kaolin clay handles the cleansing with a very mild action - which matters, because a stripped barrier makes pigmentation worse, not better. Lavender essential oil finishes it with a soft natural scent.

Built for normal and combination skin. Give it consistent daily use and judge it at the six-week mark.
Meta: _econur_positioning: Licorice, wild turmeric and honey bar that fades tanning, dark spots and pigmentation on normal to combination skin.

Description:
Fourteen ingredients, and almost all of them are doing a job. The Herbifresh Bar is the herbalist's bar in the range - a natural disinfectant that still leaves skin fed rather than bare.

Neem and green tea handle the antibacterial work, clearing away germs and going after the bacteria behind breakouts. Moringa brings the vitamins and nourishment back in. Ground oats exfoliate gently enough for daily use while doubling as a soothing agent, and blackseed oil and tulsi work on mild allergies, itching and the red spots they leave behind.

Almond, olive and blackseed oils build the conditioning base, so the deep herbal cleanse never tips into dryness. Tea tree and lavender essential oils finish it with a clean herbal scent and no synthetic fragrance anywhere in the bar.

Formulated for normal and combination skin.

Description:
This is, first and last, an olive oil bathing bar. Over 80% of it is olive oil - and that single fact is what makes it safe for the most delicate skin in your house.

Olive oil is rich in oleic acid and carries a conditioning value above 80, which means it holds moisture in the skin instead of pulling it out. At this concentration the bar is extremely mild. It does not dry skin out, it does not sting, and it leaves the skin soft rather than tight.

Kaolin clay does the cleansing with a very gentle action and leaves a silky feel afterwards. Oat milk takes down mild itching, prickly heat and inflammation - the everyday complaints of babies and reactive skin in humid weather.

There is no fragrance and no essential oil in this bar. That is deliberate: added scent is the most common trigger for infant and sensitive skin, so it is simply not there.
Meta: _econur_positioning: Ultra-mild, fragrance-free olive oil bar for babies, very dry skin and sensitive skin.

Description:
A scrub bar that does not feel like sandpaper. The Caffiend Bar is built on ground coffee and coffee water, with almond oil and milk conditioning underneath so the exfoliation never leaves skin raw.

The coffee does two jobs at once. Chemically, its compounds draw excess oil and trapped dirt out of the skin and keep pores clear, and its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial action works against acne-causing bacteria while calming redness. Physically, the grounds lift away dead skin cells - which is what brings a vibrant surface back to dull, congested skin.

The caffeine adds one more thing: it increases blood circulation at the surface, which temporarily improves the look of skin texture and reduces the appearance of puffiness and cellulite.

Best for combination and slightly oily skin. Two or three times a week is plenty.
